Copy its art style exactly: a dark warm-brown outline (never black) of even weight, soft cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, light from the top-left, warm pastel colours of medium saturation, a subtle painted texture, rounded chunky friendly shapes, low-to-medium detail. Do NOT copy the objects of image 1.

Draw ONE image: a sheet of 8 separate game sprites in a clean grid of 2 row(s) x 4 column(s), in exactly this order, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) Forage Grass sprout: three tiny fresh green grass blades; (2) Forage Grass growing: a small leafy tuft of bright green grass blades; (3) Forage Grass ripe: a thick lush round tuft of tall juicy green grass with a few soft seed tips, ready to cut for pigs; (4) Forage Grass wilted: the tuft drooping and straw-yellow.
Row 2: (1) Wheat sprout: a few thin upright green shoots; (2) Wheat growing: a clump of tall green stalks with young green ears; (3) Wheat ripe: a clump of golden stalks with five plump golden ears leaning slightly, warm honey colour; (4) Wheat wilted: grey-brown stalks bent over, ears hanging down.
Each plant is seen from the side and slightly above, standing upright; its stem ends at the bottom in a very small mound of soil. No pot, no grass patch, no ground, no cloud platform.
Each row is ONE crop plant in 4 growth stages drawn at the SAME scale: 1 sprout (tiny, two or three leaves), 2 growing (young leafy plant, about half height, nothing to harvest yet), 3 ripe (fully grown and ready to harvest, tallest, the crop clearly visible), 4 wilted (the ripe plant drooping, dry yellow-brown leaves, about the height of stage 2). Keep the same colours and leaf shape across the row.

Every object is fully visible and centred in its own cell, with wide empty gaps between objects; nothing touches, overlaps or crosses into another cell. Wide landscape image.
Background: one plain flat light-grey colour (#C8C8C8) everywhere. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow on the background.
No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, logo, border or frame. Not glossy, not a 3D render, not flat vector, not pixel art. No glow, no sparkles, no floating particles.
